title: Chicken Gyro Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make wrap filled with chicken, crunchy veggies, and tangy tzatziki sauce, all wrapped in warm flatbread. Perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and your favorite spices.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before slicing it thinly.
Warm the flatbread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the gyro by spreading tzatziki sauce on the flatbread, followed by sliced chicken, cucumber, tomato, red onion, and feta cheese.
